ATEEZ 2024 WORLD TOUR [TOWARDS THE LIGHT : WILL TO POWER] IN JAPAN [WOWOW] (1080p HD)​


​
We bring you coverage of the final day of ATEEZ's Japanese performance from their 2024 World Tour! This was their first Japanese performance in approximately nine months since May 2023, but during that time they have continued to be incredibly active. In June 2023, they released their 9th mini-album, "THE WORLD EP. 2: OUTLAW," which debuted at number 2 on the US "Billboard 200." Then, in December, they released their 2nd full album, "THE WORLD EP. FIN: WILL," which sold over 1.7 million copies in its first week, becoming their third million-seller. Furthermore, with this album, they not only debuted at number 1 on the "Billboard 200," but also reached number 2 on the UK's "Official Albums Chart," demonstrating their continued accelerating popularity on the world stage.

item.description:
ATEEZ WORLD TOUR [THE FELLOWSHIP : BREAK THE WALL] ANCHOR IN JAPAN [WOWOW] (1080p HD)​


​
In December 2022, ATEEZ held "[THE FELLOWSHIP : BREAK THE WALL] IN CHIBA" in Japan as part of their world tour. They drew approximately 30,000 people to the two-day event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, thrilling their ATINY (the name for their fans). Now, they're holding an encore performance in Japan! The broadcast and streaming will feature footage from their tour finale on May 7, 2023, at the Hyogo World Memorial Hall. This encore performance was a first for ATEEZ's Japanese shows, with all arena seats designated as standing room only. Responding to their energetic stage presence, the venue reached a fever pitch of excitement. Furthermore, their second Japanese single, "Limitless," released on March 22 of the same year, included a newly recorded original Japanese song, "DIAMOND," delighting their Japanese fans one after another. ATEEZ continues to be a worldwide artist, always looking towards the global stage. The eight members who captivate audiences with their powerful singing and dancing, and their caring and witty MCing, are back on the Japanese stage once again!



More information: https://www.wowow.co.jp/detail/191035
